female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.body: The inclusion of specific monthly income, detailed inventory lists, or precise product types accelerates funding for both men and women.

family-mention-interaction.title: Mentioning family obligations and benefits has opposite effects on funding speed by gender.
family-mention-interaction.body: Pitches from women that highlight family or community benefits fund faster, while pitches from men that mention family obligations or school fees fund more slowly.

institutional-detail-slower.title: Mentioning local currency amounts or specific institutional affiliations predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-detail-slower.body: Pitches that include specific local currency figures or name the microfinance institution tend to experience slower funding speeds for both men and women.

female-age-specificity-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their own age in the pitch fund more slowly.
female-age-specificity-slower.body: Explicitly mentioning their own age in the pitch text correlates with slower funding speeds for women.

female-child-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who list the specific ages of their children fund faster.
female-child-age-faster.body: Providing precise ages for children in the pitch text is associated with increased funding speed for women.

female-community-econ-slower.body: Female borrowers who describe the general economic activity of their local community may fund more slowly.

female-home-ownership-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific living arrangements or home ownership may fund faster.

female-loan-history-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention a history of past loan repayments may fund more slowly.

female-personal-asset-goals-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention personal asset goals like a house or fridge may fund more slowly.

female-child-count-impact.body: Female borrowers who mention exactly two children fund faster than those who mention three or more.

female-low-local-amount-faster.body: Female borrowers requesting lower amounts of local currency may fund faster than those requesting higher amounts.

female-thanks-slower.body: Female borrowers who express explicit thanks to lenders may fund more slowly.

female-routine-description-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide detailed descriptions of daily routines and childcare duties may fund more slowly.

male-thanks-faster.body: Male borrowers who express explicit thanks to lenders may fund faster.

female-education-mention-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention children's education or schooling may fund more slowly.

female-husband-partnership-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention working together with a husband may fund faster.
female-husband-partnership-faster.retrospective: Dropped as oldest puzzle to maintain puzzle cap.

female-logistical-details-slower.title: Female borrowers who include specific logistical details like working hours or commute distance may fund more slowly.
female-logistical-details-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that numerical logistical details like working hours predict faster funding.

female-aspirational-language-slower.title: Female borrowers who use broad, aspirational language regarding the future or community may fund more slowly.
female-aspirational-language-slower.retrospective: Dropped as oldest puzzle to maintain puzzle cap.

female-thanks-slower.title: Female borrowers who express explicit thanks to lenders in their pitch may fund more slowly.
female-thanks-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that thanks accelerate funding.

female-thriving-business-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly describe their business as thriving may fund faster.
female-thriving-business-faster.retrospective: Retired as oldest puzzle to make room for child count observation.

male-age-specificity-faster.title: Male borrowers who explicitly include their specific age in the pitch may fund faster.
male-age-specificity-faster.retrospective: Dropped as oldest puzzle to maintain puzzle cap.

female-thanks-faster.title: Female borrowers who express explicit thanks to lenders may fund faster.
female-thanks-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that the slower pitch includes a direct thank you to lenders.

female-pitch-length-faster.title: Female borrowers who write significantly lengthier pitches may fund faster.
female-pitch-length-faster.retrospective: Dropped as oldest puzzle to maintain puzzle cap.

female-emotive-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use more emotive language in their pitches may fund faster.
female-emotive-language-faster.retrospective: Dropped as oldest stale puzzle to maintain puzzle cap.

female-personal-history-slower.title: Female borrowers who emphasize personal history over business specifics may fund more slowly.
female-personal-history-slower.retrospective: Dropped as oldest puzzle to make room for education observation.
